lessons: The mission's literal lsof command (lsof -ti -sTCP:LISTEN :PORT) is invalid on macOS; use lsof -nP -iTCP:PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t. Plain lsof -ti :PORT also returns client sockets.

ps RSS is not a usable memory measure for MLX (10 MB for a 4.7 GB worker on a long-lived server because the pages are compressed; 0.3-2 GB on fresh ones); use footprint -p PID on the listening worker, and measure after a warm-up generation because the model loads lazily (fresh 0.5-3.3 GB, warm about 4.3 GB).
A stop check that compares the listener PID with the launcher PID reports success while the worker survives; verify by checking nothing listens on the port and no tracked process is alive.
Signal a process group only when every member is an MLX process; otherwise tree-kill the worker and launcher. Never signal a state-file PID that no longer looks like an MLX process.

Reaping must be limited to servers the manager started; a hand-launched persistent daemon is never reaped. Pre-register thresholds with the measurement point (fresh vs warm) stated, or the first live run can miss for a reason that is about measurement, not the code.

lessons: In-process bootloader execution eliminates secondary python interpreter spawn overhead. Traversal for project root must anchor on current working directory or harness env vars rather than hook file location to respect isolated context guards.

Surfacing a predecessor relay in the boot briefing triples a 7B incoming agent's correctness and halves its discovery work, but does not by itself reach 90%: the weak agent often ignores the briefing and digs with tools; the answers were present every time.

Measure the incoming agent's tool-call syntax before attributing control failures to missing information: a control run failed four turns in a row on <search_text>query</search_text>, a parse artifact that would have inflated the relay's value; the shared loop now accepts that form.
A handoff note states the next step last, so a short display cap hides the most important part; show recent notes up to two thirds of the storage cap and keep the whole section under a fixed budget.
Only 2 of 10 resolved missions cite a file path as evidence; the relay falls back to the experiment log or the mission manifest. Record-result callers should pass --citation with a path.

Format placeholders in a question (VERDICT | path) can be copied literally by a small model; use a worked example or JSON in the answer format. Test frontier incoming agents and relay-first placement next (MISSION-032).

lessons: The naive 25% null is wrong for primes of finite size: a Cramer random model already gives 16-20% for same-digit returns because of geometric waiting; compare against the model, not the naive value.

lessons: Random-walk Braess paradox in trees is strictly local in cycle length (100% at d<=4, 87.65% at d=2 across n=7..11), so its share of all C(n-1,2) missing edges falls with n even as maximum slowdown magnitude grows linearly with n.

Diameter-endpoint shortcuts are not immune when tree diameter itself is small (diam in {2,3,4}, e.g., connecting leaves of a star or double-star); immunity holds only when shortcut distance d_T(u,v) >= 5.
